shots.title: Clear CodeQL wildcard replacement alert in workflow resync scorecard lookup (#518)
shots.notes: Replaced first-only scorecard pattern substitution with all-wildcard replacement in workflow resync and the sibling sprint-completion guard; added regressions for multi-wildcard scorecard patterns.

shots.title: Replace CodeQL-flagged git shell commands with argument-array process calls (#518)
shots.notes: Changed flow staleness and MCP testing worktree cleanup to use `execFileSync` argument arrays for git diff, worktree removal, branch deletion, and worktree pruning.

shots.title: Rerun focused tests and PR check validation for CodeQL release gate (#518)
shots.notes: Focused tests, build, typecheck, full suite, map, roadmap, and PR #508 checks passed after the fix; CodeQL aggregate now reports success at head eb4815174038ce14b0d4a569d38ef010f3799079.

conditions.description: The normal CI job passed before the aggregate GitHub Advanced Security CodeQL check failed, so release validation had to inspect both Actions jobs and external check-run annotations.

training.description: Release-gate status should include aggregate security checks, not only workflow job conclusions.
training.outcome: S143.99 inspected the CodeQL check-run annotations, fixed each changed-code alert, and waited for the PR checks to turn green.

training.description: Git commands that consume runtime paths or refs should use argument arrays.
training.outcome: The changed code now avoids shell interpolation for the CodeQL-flagged git paths.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts tests/cli/guards/sprint-completion.test.ts tests/core/flows.test.ts tests/mcp/index-src.test.ts` passed: 157 tests.
`corepack pnpm test` passed: 232 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3632 tests passed, 25 skipped.
PR #508 checks passed at eb4815174038ce14b0d4a569d38ef010f3799079: ci, CodeQL, Analyze (actions), Analyze (javascript-typescript), and GitGuardian.
`node dist/cli/index.js map --check` and `node dist/cli/index.js roadmap validate` passed with only standing historical roadmap warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A sharp little release-gate catch: the code was working, but CodeQL was right to demand safer command construction.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When a PR check line is an aggregate security check, fetch its annotations directly before assuming the underlying Actions jobs tell the whole story.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The aggregate CodeQL check failed even though both named CodeQL workflow jobs were otherwise healthy.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S144 can now use checks-passing release readiness without carrying a hidden CodeQL failure.

bunker_locations: Aggregate security checks can fail independently of GitHub Actions job conclusions.
First-only wildcard replacement in scorecard patterns is a portability bug when custom patterns contain more than one wildcard.
Git commands that take branch names, refs, or paths should use `execFileSync` argument arrays instead of shell strings.
yardage_book_updates: `scorecardPattern` wildcard substitution in workflow resync and sprint-completion now replaces every wildcard.
MCP testing worktree cleanup now uses argument-array git calls for worktree removal, branch deletion, and pruning.
